description_citations.text: "Vaash Vroga". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz, a Primeval, is reincarnated as a Shivan dragon.
timeline.quote: The Primeval dragon Darigaaz was not originally a Shivan dragon, but was reincarnated as one

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon species". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza recruits Szat for the Nine Titans, but Szat betrays them, frees the Primeval Dragons through Darigaaz and kills Daria and Kristina.
timeline.quote: However, Szat betrayed the Titans, convinced Darigaaz to free the Primeval Dragons , and killed Daria and Kristina of the Woods .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz decides his foe will be more useful as a weapon.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz decided his foe would be more useful as a weapon.

citation.text: Backlash (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz the legend of the Primeval Dragons and shows him the destroyed red Primeval's corpse in Shiv, saying the others can be awakened to aid the war.
timeline.quote: He showed Darigaaz the corpse of the red Primeval in Shiv

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Original Incarnation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz slays the rebellious dragon lord Rokun and throws his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree, which frees Rith.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz slew the upstart, throwing his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rith takes charge of the dragons and Darigaaz falls into line behind her.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz, awestruck, fell into line behind her leadership.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At New Argive, Rith lets four dragon lords incinerate themselves with mana, and Treva is reborn; Darigaaz forbids further mortal sacrifices.
timeline.quote: the sacrifice worked and Treva was reborn.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Treva". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Primevals break into Dromar's treasure cave beneath the ocean and Rith destroys part of the hoard to awaken him.
timeline.quote: To awaken him, Rith destroyed part of the hoard.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Dromar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Urborg Rith reveals that the other four Primevals must sacrifice themselves, and that Darigaaz is himself the red Primeval; they throw themselves into Crosis' tar pit, freeing him.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz and the other Primevals threw themselves into Crosis' tar pit prison, freeing him.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Crosis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reborn as a god, Darigaaz and the other Primevals chase the Weatherlight through the clouds.
timeline.quote: They set upon the vessel, furiously chasing it through the clouds.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn touches Darigaaz's mind and he comes to his senses; horrified, Darigaaz throws himself into a volcano, breaking the pantheon and weakening the other Primevals so they can be slain.
timeline.quote: chose to throw himself into a volcano

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, a new Darigaaz hatches from an egg, lives among the Ghitu, and becomes champion of the dragons of Shiv.
timeline.quote: This Darigaaz hatched from an egg found in a temporal rift

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Reincarnation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Tevesh Szat reveals the Primevals to Rhammidarigaaz.
timeline.quote: Tevesh Szat revealed the existence of the Primevals to Rhammidarigaaz

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Primeval Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn convinces Darigaaz of his folly.
timeline.quote: until Karn convinced Darigaaz of his folly

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Primeval Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz kills himself by plunging into a volcano, after which the other Primevals can be defeated.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz committed suicide by plunging into a volcano

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Primeval Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz dies defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled gods.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

citation.text: Terminate (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz declares sacrificing mortal dragons must end.
timeline.quote: Sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy your immortal hunger ends here.

citation.text: Insolence (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz about the primevals; Darigaaz sets out to save the others.
timeline.quote: but Darigaaz sets out to save the others nonetheless.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz resurrects Rith, Dromar and Treva and learns he is the red Primeval; the four sacrifice themselves in a tar-pit, awakening Crosis, who completes the chain of power.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz himself is the red Primeval.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn talks sense into Darigaaz, who plunges into an active volcano to stop the Primevals' complete power.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz sees his mistakes and plunges himself into an active volcano

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz gives his life defending Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria

citation.text: Terminate (World Championship Decks 2001, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Josu starts a ritual to resurrect Kyashatar; the Traveler duels him and lays her to rest again.
timeline.quote: the Traveler dueled Josu and laid Kyashatar to rest once again

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Darigaaz form the Shivan Nation in 4520 AR.
timeline.quote: she was instrumental in forming the Shivan Nation in 4520 AR

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Shivan Nation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Hero assassinates Kyashatar and frees Darigaaz.
timeline.quote: Within Kyashatar's lair, the Hero assassinated the dragon broodmother and councilmember.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Josu Vess has Kyashatar reanimated, and the Traveler slays the revenant.
timeline.quote: The Traveler then slew the reanimated Kyashatar, and Darigaaz saw to his proper burial.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Shiv, Vaash uses a curiosity to control Keltaz, who kills Benalish soldiers, and kills Squee and other goblins.
timeline.quote: causing Keltaz to kill several Benalish soldiers.

citation.text: "Vaash Vroga", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
timeline.quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz and the dragons dive at the Weatherlight and rake its cables.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz threw himself at the Weatherlight 's hull

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz gives his life defending Dominaria from self-styled gods.
timeline.quote: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

citation.text: Terminate (Dominaria United Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After a winged Phyrexian attacks the Weatherlight, Darigaaz and the dragons join the New Coalition and fight in the Battle of the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He was present and fought in the Battle of the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz is never kept down by death for long.
timeline.quote: Death has never kept Darigaaz down for long.

citation.text: Pyretic Rebirth (Modern Horizons 3, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Coalition divides to focus on several confrontations after the victory at Koilos and the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: the Coalition forces were divided to focus on several specific confrontations

citation.text: "Coalition", section "Counterattack". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Deniz met the red-haired planeswalker, who helped him frame Darigaaz; Deniz put Darigaaz into an unconscious state while Keltaz was controlled to attack Benalish soldiers.
timeline.quote: Deniz met the red-haired planeswalker , who helped him frame Darigaaz .

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Deniz had Darigaaz framed for the deaths of his soldiers and demanded his arrest before the Shivan Council, winning the favor of Kyashatar and her brood.
timeline.quote: Deniz had Darigaaz framed for the deaths of his soldiers

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Squee led Darigaaz, Adeliz and the Traveler to reclaim the Mana Rig; the Traveler dispatched Deniz at the rig's helm.
timeline.quote: Squee led Darigaaz, Adeliz , and the Traveler in a campaign to reclaim the Mana Rig.

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Mana Rig". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rith, imprisoned in Nemata by the Numena, is freed first by Darigaaz.
timeline.quote: The primeval dragon Rith was originally imprisoned inside Nemata in Yavimaya by the Numena

citation.text: "Nemata", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rith is the first freed by Rhammidarigaaz after Tevesh Szat tells him of the Primevals; she dominates Darigaaz's mind to free all the primevals.
timeline.quote: she dominated Darigaaz's mind, convincing him to free all of the primevals regardless of the cost to mortal dragon lives

citation.text: "Rith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rith is freed again during the second Phyrexian Invasion when her psychic connection to her reincarnated brother reawakens her.
timeline.quote: when her psychic connection to her reincarnated brother reawakened her

citation.text: "Rith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: until Karn convinced Darigaaz of his folly

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Primeval Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: She is the daughter of Palladia-Mors and the sister of Darigaaz .

citation.text: "Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
